scope: Post-run interpretation of the published training metrics only. This file does not invent environmental findings that are not supported by scene-level provenance and measurements.

findings.title: The optimization run converged on its self-supervised objective
findings.statement: The run completed the full 60-minute CUDA window and reduced reconstruction/denoising loss from 0.291329 to 0.046198, an 84.14% reduction. The best observed loss was 0.028217, 90.31% below the initial value.
findings.supports: The training loop, CUDA path, mixed-precision path and optimization objective were functioning together for the full run.
findings.does_not_support: It does not establish environmental-change detection accuracy or scientific generalization.

findings.title: The first run was a narrow-corpus baseline rather than a broad Earth survey
findings.statement: 704,232 training samples were generated from only 66 source images, averaging about 10,670 sampled training patches per source image. Those samples are repeated crops/patches, not unique satellite scenes.
findings.supports: The run exercised the model many times and is useful as a pipeline and representation-learning baseline.
findings.does_not_support: The repeated sampling cannot be presented as hundreds of thousands of independent Earth observations.

findings.title: Generalization risk is high until held-out validation is performed
findings.statement: Because the public run contains 66 source images but no published per-image held-out validation result, the strong training-loss reduction may include memorization of recurring visual structures. Generalization must be tested on unseen, provenance-complete scenes.
findings.supports: This is a methodological risk assessment based on the corpus size and self-supervised training design.
findings.does_not_support: It is not a measured overfitting percentage and should not be treated as one.

findings.title: No auditable site-level environmental conclusion can be recovered from the public Run #1 artifact alone
findings.statement: The published Run #1 summary does not contain a per-image manifest linking all 66 source images to location, acquisition date, sensor, scene identifier and quality flags. Therefore a public reader cannot reproducibly assign the training behavior to specific rivers, lakes, deserts, mountains or countries.
findings.supports: This identifies the provenance gap that later runs must close.
findings.does_not_support: It does not mean the images lacked geography locally; it means the public Run #1 artifact does not contain enough provenance to audit environmental findings.

comparison_to_run_2.note: Run #2 expanded the public corpus and added per-image GPU audit/provenance structure. Loss values between Run #1 and Run #2 must not be ranked as model quality because the corpora differ.

scientific_status.reason: No scene-level validated change measurements are part of the public Run #1 artifact.

required_for_future_reports: Per-scene location, date, sensor and source identifier
Deterministic measurements such as water area, shoreline displacement, river width, snow/ice fraction or vegetation index
Region-level findings with OBSERVATION / DERIVED_VALUE / MODEL_ESTIMATE / HYPOTHESIS / UNKNOWN labels
A separate count of unique decoded satellite windows versus repeated training samples
